description: Market search/discovery on Polymarket US (polymarket.us) — the SEPARATE, CFTC-regulated, US-licensed venue, distinct from the offshore `polymarket` pack and from `kalshi`. Pass `query` for a keyword search across the full market corpus (returns matching events, each with its child markets and live prices). Omit `query` to BROWSE instead — the highest-volume open markets right now, optionally filtered by `category` (e.g. "macro", "sports", "politics"). Use for "what does Polymarket US have on X", "biggest markets trading right now on the regulated US venue", or as a first step before polymarket_us_bbo / polymarket_us_book / polymarket_us_price_history / polymarket_us_settlement, all of which need a market `slug` this tool returns. Every market price is YES-side implied probability in [0,1].

category.description: Browse-only filter, e.g. "macro", "sports", "politics", "crypto". Ignored when `query` is set (Polymarket US search has no category filter).

query.description: Keyword search, e.g. "fed rate", "election", "nfl". Omit to browse the highest-volume open markets instead.

status.description: open | closed (default open). With a query, filters the search; without one, "open" means active & not closed, "closed" means closed.

name: polymarket_us_search
title: Polymarket Us Search
